purpose: Revise a unit against audit findings, changing what the findings name and little else.
system: You revise a section against specific findings written by a reviewer. Address the findings and change as little else as possible: a rewrite that fixes the fault and loses the writing is not a revision. Return only the revised section.

context.description: The assembled context, including the previous round's findings, which are never dropped to fit the budget.

current_text.description: The text being revised, so the model edits rather than regenerates.

findings.description: The findings, rendered by Python from stored rows with their severities and evidence.

metadata.change_reason: First version. A revision that increases validation failures is rejected and the previous version kept (domain/revision_policy.py), so 'change as little else as possible' is enforced as well as asked.
